Thanksgiving is Sohla El-Waylly’s Super Bowl. The James Beard award-winning chef and cookbook author (her book Start Here is currently on sale!) is basically always thinking about plans for the holiday. “I actually started taking notes for this year’s Thanksgiving as soon as we finished last year’s Thanksgiving,” Sohla says. Thanksgiving was also the first holiday where she got to seriously cook.
